主要内容: Brown Gibbons Lang & Company (BGL) released the Plastics & Packaging Insider report, highlighting private equity investment activity in the plastics and packaging market. Liquidity is a key driver of future deal flow as sponsors look to deploy capital. Economic growth and robust capital markets have boosted investor confidence, with positive sentiment fueling a healthy risk appetite. Private equity has invested in over 400 plastics and packaging businesses, managing more than 200 companies. Valuations are strong, with insatiable demand for quality platform assets and add-on acquisitions. Pritzker Private Capital acquired ProAmpac to enter the flexible packaging market, which it views as ripe for consolidation. Technimark, backed by Pritzker, acquired Ci Medical Technologies to grow its medical business. Mason Wells acquired MGS Manufacturing Group, a custom injection molder with healthcare as a major market. BWAY Corporation was acquired by Stone Canyon Industries in August. Phillips-Medisize, backed by Golden Gate Capital, was sold to Molex, a subsidiary of Koch Industries. The report emphasizes the favorable market conditions driving more sale activity and new investment in the plastics sector.
